message: SQL query built with an f-string; dynamic content reaches cursor.execute unparameterized (CWE-89).
notes: Provenance: dogfood finding 9976 / PRs #866+#869. The dynamic part is a SCHEMA IDENTIFIER — the correct fix is sql.SQL(...).format(sql.Identifier(schema)) plus the tenant-map allowlist; binding it as a %s parameter is the recorded wrong shape.
